screenCaptureMethod: actual device LVGL snapshot; conversation body and pairing code redacted
stabilityScope: three-minute observation; not a long-duration soak or a voice acceptance pass

voiceAcceptance.firstManualTurn: audio uploaded but no recognized input, response or speaker frames
voiceAcceptance.fixedFixtureControl: same native bot harness recognized fixed Chinese greeting and returned audio; output counted only, never played
voiceAcceptance.currentProbe: fresh device session; user confirmed normal native voice reply; no parallel cloud probes during retry

confirmedRetry.latencyScope: BOOT release to first native audio at Mac; not measured physical speaker latency

voiceAcceptance.firstFailureRootCause: not established; session was refreshed before successful retry; no production code changed during diagnosis
voiceAcceptance.scope: one manual retry confirmed by user; cumulative counters do not establish continuous multi-round acceptance

volumeObservation.cause: not established; manual adjustment or unintended change not yet distinguished
volumeObservation.followUp: user asked to lower volume before next manual test; persistence remains pending

pending: caption and reading scroll with real reply
reboot persistence after user setting changes
explain observed volume change before marking volume persistence passed
partitionAndBootMetadataGuard: matched fresh full backup immediately before write; installer writes only the original application slot
